register.p: Then register it in ~/.config/goose/config.yaml (Windows: %APPDATA%\Block\goose\config\config.yaml). Merge this into the file, keeping every extension already there. Create the file if it doesn't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists, ask the user before replacing it. Add this under the existing extensions: key:

confirm.p: Goose loads extensions when a session starts. Tell the user to start a new session and check {{SERVER}} is listed (goose configure → Toggle Extensions).
